Support: https://ko-fi.com/flashyreese

releases.notes:
## New

- Added **NeoForge support** alongside Fabric, with separate downloads for each loader and Minecraft version.

**NeoForge does not support Placeholder API.** The existing server-side Placeholder API integration remains available on Fabric.

## Fixes and improvements

- Fixed server-side execution of custom commands and redirects. ([#38](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/issues/38))
- Fixed aliases failing to find commands that include arguments, such as `gamemode survival`, `trigger bid set`, or a specific `function` command. ([#59](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/issues/59), [#67](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/issues/67), [#80](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/issues/80))
- Fixed errors when enabling MySQL storage, including failures when creating the database tables. ([#50](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/issues/50))
- Improved database connection handling, reconnection, and cleanup when leaving a game or stopping a server.
- Fixed conflicting bundled libraries that could prevent Minecraft from starting.
- Improved error messages and loading logs to make problems with alias files easier to identify.

## Fixes brought to older Minecraft versions

- **1.21.1:** Included the client custom-command fix previously released for newer Minecraft versions. Server actions are sent to the server without the reported client crash, and client actions execute instead of being printed in chat. ([#65](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/issues/65))
- **1.21.1:** Included earlier improvements to redirects for modded commands, such as WorldEdit, and corrected player-world lookup with `$get_world()`. ([#73](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/pull/73), [#77](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/pull/77))
- **1.21.1, 1.21.11, and 26.1.2:** Included improved execution ordering for custom commands with multiple actions and conditional follow-up actions. This improvement was already available on 26.2 and 26.3. ([#51](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/issues/51))

## Documentation

- Updated project and in-game help links to the [new Command Aliases wiki](https://wiki.flashyreese.me/books/command-aliases). ([#78](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/issues/78))
- Added a clearer [COMMAND_LIST_LOOKUP guide](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/blob/gitbook/command-modes/custom/suggestion-provider-component.md#command_list_lookup) explaining how to reuse another command's tab-completion suggestions. ([#61](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/issues/61))

## Notes for database users

- If the configured database cannot be opened, Command Aliases now logs a warning and uses temporary in-memory storage. **Values stored in this fallback are not saved between sessions.**
- MySQL tables are updated automatically when needed. The configured database account must have permission to update the table structure.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/compare/mc26.3-1.0.4...mc26.3-1.1.0

releases.notes:
# Important Notice
You will need to update your `0.9.x` formats to be compatible with `1.0.0`. Please [visit the wiki](https://wiki.commandaliases.flashyreese.me/) to view the documentation. I will be trying my best to improve the wiki, you can also help by contributing to it.

# What's changed?
- Specification has been changed - Wiki can be found [here](https://wiki.commandaliases.flashyreese.me/)
    - You now need to define `schemaVersion` to `1`
    - Formats are pretty much identifical but instead of `"customCommand": {}`, you just define everything in the base clause where the Command Mode is located.
    - Some custom command format fields has been renamed, you can find more information about it on the wiki.
- Removed all deprecated features from 0.9.x.
    - `COMMAND_ALIAS`, `COMMAND_REASSIGN_AND_ALIAS` and `COMMAND_REASSIGN_AND_CUSTOM` - You can still reassign commands but they would require separate files, this change is done to keep debugging easier.
- Added more formatting types and functions
    - Formatting Types can be found [here](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/blob/1.19.x/dev/src/main/java/me/flashyreese/mods/commandaliases/command/impl/FormattingTypeProcessor.java).
    - Functions can be found [here](https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/blob/1.19.x/dev/src/main/java/me/flashyreese/mods/commandaliases/command/impl/FunctionProcessor.java).
- Added MySQL, Redis, In-Memory database implementations
- Added a math numerical expression evaluator and a boolean expression evaluator using Javaluator
- Enabled all JSON5 features for serialization
- Improved logging to help identify errors cause by a particular file. (I will be improving this further in the future)
- Tons of more changes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FlashyReese/CommandAliases/compare/mc1.19.2-1.0.0...mc1.19.3-1.0.0
